# using-vv

## Iron Law

```
Entry skill must route — never do stage work itself.
```

## When to Use

- The fixture entry skill applies.
- Routing to vv-hello for the hello action.

## Steps

1. Route to vv-hello.

## Red Flags — STOP and Rethink

- Doing stage work instead of routing
- Skipping the handoff to vv-hello

## 自检清单 (Post-routing Self-Check)

- [ ] Target skill identified: vv-hello
- [ ] Iron Law restated: routing only
- [ ] Handoff artifact prepared
